description: This file implements the LibMediaPlayerImpl class, which manages media player initialization, cleanup, and CAS data handling for a media platform. It includes methods for opening and closing media sessions, setting environment variables, and handling callbacks for media events and errors.

classes.name: LibMediaPlayerImpl
classes.description: A class managing media player setup, event handling, and CAS data transmission.

methods.name: openMediaPlayer
methods.description: Initializes and opens a media player session or CAS service based on session type.

methods.name: closeMediaPlayer
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the media player or CAS service session.

methods.name: requestCASData
methods.description: Sends CAS data to the media player or CAS service.

methods.name: eventCallBack
methods.description: Handles media player events and forwards messages to the session manager.
